C0885.title: Bo Software Company Illegally Harvests Hospital Appointment User Privacy Case
C0885.summary: Bo Software Company, He, and others illegally obtained personal information of online hospital registration users during development and maintenance of a hospital registration system and were sentenced. The case shows that if a system developer or maintainer uses operational privileges, backend interfaces, or data export capabilities to collect patient information beyond authorization, it can trigger personal information protection, medical data security, and outsourced service provider management risks.

references.title: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of People's Courts Punishing Crimes Infringing on Citizens' Personal Information and Related Offenses
